incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty PD-78921 triggered — hotqueue "inference-hot" queue depth 92% (us-west-2). Autoscaler didn't scale. Runbook: https://runbooks.redwood/queue-hot
Maya: Ack. I'm taking this. Checking autoscaler controller logs and provider quotas.
Tom: I'm on pager as well — will rotate to incident channel. Any customer impact yet?
Maya: Found errors in scale-controller: API rate limit / 403 InsufficientQuota from provider. Snippet:
```
E 03/17 12:01:23 scale-controller.go:412 request failed: ProviderError: InsufficientQuota
status: 403
```
Kai: Seeing several 5xxs surfaced from gateway and slow tails. Customer-facing latency up ~1200ms for some rungs. Marking customer-impact: P2 for now :warning:
Tom: Trying manual spin-up: `kubectl scale deploy/inference-hot --replicas=6 -n prod` -> Pending nodes due to quota. Can't attach new GPUs.
Maya: Opening a support request with cloud provider, also trying fallback: route low-priority traffic to dedicated-durable variants. Applying temporary throttling policy.
OncallLead: @infra-team can you check quota/limit increases? If manual bump not possible, we need to reduce throughput via circuit-breaker.
Ops: We've applied a soft circuit-breaker to ingress to cap concurrency to 50% for non-critical customers. Monitoring queue depth.
Maya: Queue depth dropped to 65% after throttle, latencies trending down. Will keep monitoring for next 15m.
incident-bot: PD-78921 acked by Maya at 1719876600
Kai: Customer A's requests still impacted — reached out to CS to notify impacted customers and open ticket.
Tom: Plan: 1) wait for provider quota fix, 2) keep soft throttle for 20m, 3) run postmortem if quota change required. Assigning follow-ups: Maya (root cause + logs), Ops (mitigation timeline), Kai (customer comms).
Maya: Filing quick incident note in /incidents/PD-78921 and capturing controller logs.
Ops: Removing soft throttle in 18m if stable. :thumbsup:
Maya: Closing PD-78921 on PagerDuty, will reopen if queue rises. Final check: queue at 28%, tail latencies normalized.
